atoms.b: Should our school canteen only offer vegan meals from now on?

((++In_my_opinion I_see_your_point)), our school lunches should definitely be vegan, ((++due_to_the_fact_that therefore)) a vegan diet is more environmentally friendly than meals that contain meat, since they create fewer greenhouse gas emission.

((That_is_exactly_how_I_see_it I’m_not_sure_about_that)). ((++I_think I_disagree)), only offering vegan meals in schools is more inclusive, since there are students at our school that don't eat certain types of meat ((++because_of that's_why)) religious reasons. ((++For_instance First_of_all)), Muslims and Jews don’t eat pork and Hindus don't eat beef.

((++I_see_what_you_mean I_completely_agree_with_you)), however only offering vegan meals limits cultural diversity at our school, ((++as thus)) there are many traditional meals in different cultures that include meat and dairy products. ((++For_that_reason For_example)), ((++I'd_say I_agree)) that the school canteen shouldn't only offer vegan options.

I ((++agree suppose)) with Larissa. Some students like to eat meals that include meat and dairy products, and we shouldn't force them to give that up during the school day, since it would restrict their freedom of choice. That's why ((++I_believe I_agree)) our school canteen should still offer meals with meat.

((++I'd_like_to_summarise_that What’s_your_opinion_on_this)) we ((++feel oppose)) that our school canteen should definitely offer vegan lunches for students that don't eat animal products, but they should not only serve vegan lunches for the students that do eat meat and dairy products.
